blueprint_concepts: Binomial theorem for a positive integral index; general term
Coefficient of a specified power of x
english: For each positive integer $n$, let $c_{n}$ denote the coefficient of $x^{n}$ in the expansion of $\left(x^{2}-\dfrac{3}{x}\right)^{n}$, $x\neq0$ (with $c_{n}=0$ if $x^{n}$ does not occur). Then the value of $\displaystyle\sum_{n=1}^{9}c_{n}$ is ______.
hindi: प्रत्येक धनात्मक पूर्णांक $n$ के लिए माना $c_{n}$, $\left(x^{2}-\dfrac{3}{x}\right)^{n}$, $x\neq0$, के प्रसार में $x^{n}$ का गुणांक है (यदि $x^{n}$ प्रसार में नहीं आता तो $c_{n}=0$)। तब $\displaystyle\sum_{n=1}^{9}c_{n}$ का मान ______ है।
solution_full: The term in $x^{n}$ needs $2n-3r=n$, i.e. $r=\dfrac{n}{3}$. This is an integer in $[0,n]$ only when $3\mid n$.
So for $n=1,2,4,5,7,8$ the power $x^{n}$ does not occur and $c_{n}=0$.
originality_note: New: a sequence defined by a moving target power (the coefficient of x^n in the n-th power), which is non-zero only when 3 | n (way 2, a function defined by a construction). Closest known: coefficient of a fixed power x^k in (x^2 - a/x)^n. Different because: the target power and the index move together, so the student must decide for which n the term exists before computing.

concept_use.Binomial theorem for a positive integral: General term C(n,r)(-3)^r x^(2n-3r) of (x^2 - 3/x)^n for each n.
concept_use.Coefficient of a specified power of x: The coefficient of the specified power x^n requires 2n - 3r = n, r = n/3, giving c_3, c_6, c_9.

stem_review: Read as a student: c_n defined for every n including the case when x^n is absent, x non-zero stated; answer -2142 is a negative integer as planned; Hindi mirrors. No change.
key_step: Solve 2n - 3r = n to see that only n = 3, 6, 9 contribute, then three general-term evaluations with signs.
justification: General-term work repeated for a family with a divisibility filter and alternating signs; numerical answer with several places to slip. Placed with the L3 numerical anchors such as 2026-P1-Q11 (L3).
